title: SandboxTemplate
description: The declarative recipe a sandbox is created from: image, isolation class and resources. The egress allowlist follows with the egress proxy.

name.description: Name other kinds refer to, e.g. an agent profile's sandbox field.

image.description: OCI image reference, pinned to an exact tag or digest. The image must provide `sleep` and must already be present on the sandbox host; the platform does not pull images at runtime.

isolationClass.description: How strongly the sandbox is separated from its host (ADR 0001). `container` shares the host kernel; `gvisor` needs a Linux host with the gVisor runtime installed.

user.description: Numeric uid[:gid] every process in the sandbox runs as. Root (0) is not allowed.
